## Plume forcing: accepted by the parser, never installed (`forcing/plume-forcing`) {#sec-ch09-plume}

### Summary

`PlumeForcingImpl::forward` ({{< code src/forcing/plume_forcing.cpp PlumeForcingImpl::forward >}}) adds entrainment
and buoyancy sources for a one-dimensional plume model whose primitive vector is radius, vertical velocity, buoyancy
and a fourth variable, with options `entrainment` (default 0.1) and `N2` (default 0). The key `plume-forcing` is on
the list `check_keys` accepts ({{< code src/hydro/hydro_options.cpp HydroOptionsImpl::from_yaml >}}), but its options
are parsed and the module is installed only when the equation of state is `plume-eos`
({{< code src/hydro/hydro_options.cpp HydroOptionsImpl::from_yaml >}},
{{< code src/hydro/register_forcing_modules.cpp HydroImpl::_register_forcings_module >}}), and
`EquationOfStateImpl::create` refuses that type as unknown
({{< code src/eos/equation_of_state.cpp EquationOfStateImpl::create >}}). So a deck with `plume-forcing:` is accepted
and the key has no effect. No test exercises the module; `plume_forcing_refuses_an_unknown_key`
({{< code tests/test_yaml_keys.cpp yaml_keys.plume_forcing_refuses_an_unknown_key >}}) only checks that, with the
equation of state set to `plume-eos` in the card, the parser refuses an unknown key in its options. The module is
dead code and this report does not describe it further.

### Derivation

No active numerical scheme is derived for this unavailable module.

### Numerical method

No active solver path uses it at the pin, as the source inventory above records.

### Code

The parser accepts `plume-forcing`, but the required `plume-eos` is refused.

### Tests

The key-refusal test above is parser evidence only; there is no plume evolution test.

### Limits

This entry documents unavailable code, not a usable closure.
